propositions: Provider qualifiers are currently decided by regex shape matching on a pre-colon prefix, which silently accepts typos and would incorrectly promote any future dotless identifier as a provider name
The correct decision criterion is membership in a known static set of provider names, matching the pattern used by pydantic-ai, LangChain, and LiteLLM

An explicitly configured provider must validate against the registry at config resolution time, rejecting typos early; an unrecognized inline prefix must remain unqualified without raising, to preserve colon-bearing model ids

The 24 member provider names are the union of pydantic-ai's enumerated providers and rebar's own builders, without exceptions; test and google_genai are excluded because they are not real providers in upstream registries
Slashed provider names like gateway/openai are currently rejected by the shape regex and must be accepted by membership testing
A drift test must enforce that the static set and runtime registries stay in sync across pydantic-ai upgrades
